text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: This is so, so very frustrating~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Kawakami-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Guhh~~!! My legs! Why couldn't these legs 
break away from the pack?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
And after we finally got to run with 
Fine-san again, too! If this were Pre-Fi, 
I would've totally blown right past 
them... right past...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"I gave my rival a grand send-off~!! 
*Waaahh*!!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Kawakami-chan. Here... look.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap, clap, clap, clap...!!)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone is applauding. Because every 
single one of us ran with all our might."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Kawakami-chan. Because you 
declared me your rival, I learned the joy 
of competing.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I cannot make any promises, but... would 
you run with me again, Princess?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Of course! Even if it costs me my life...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Fine Motiooon!! Fiiiine!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators A & B
text_block_list.text:
"Fine Motiooooon!! *sniff*... 
Waaaahhhhh~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Please, go on ahead, Fine-san.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I will keep my eyes fixed on your back 
with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'm home, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Uh—
choice_data_list: We still have time, don't we?
We still have time, don't we?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...! Yeah, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I can still run anywhere, and as far as we 
want... with you!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Until the day our true farewell awaits. 
Let's make the best memories together!
